triggers.name: guard_event_identity
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER guard_event_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON public.events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION events_identity_private.guard_event_identity()

functionVerification.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION events_identity_private.guard_event_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF current_user IN ('anon','authenticated')
 AND (NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
   OR NEW.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.club_id
   OR NEW.created_by_auth_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by_auth_user_id)
 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION '開催のID・所属グループ・作成者は変更できません' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
